program_overview.title: Python Programming Masterclass
program_overview.tagline: One language, learned to professional depth: core Python, the working toolkit, and an honest guided taste of the three roads beyond.
program_overview.description:
Python is the most useful single language a professional can learn, and the most commonly half-learned. This live online masterclass fixes the half: nine months from zero to genuinely advanced Python, the kind that reads stdlib source without fear, plus the professional toolkit, testing, Git, virtual environments, APIs, automation and concurrency, that turns language skill into working capability.

The scope is deliberately honest. Web frameworks, data science and machine learning are each their own multi-month disciplines, and this course refuses to fake all three in survey weeks. Instead, the final month is a guided, hands-on taste of the three roads, a real Flask build, a real pandas analysis, a real AI-API script, so every graduate chooses their specialization from experience rather than marketing, and continues into our dedicated Django, data analysis or AI courses with the Python depth those courses quietly assume.

The pace is real: nine months at two live classes a week plus four to six hours of practice, with two more months in hand when needed. Problem sets after every class, monthly mixed reviews that reach back deliberately, phase exams, and a final exam that decides the certificate, with focused revision and a free retest. Real Python, real depth, depth over dopamine.
what_makes_this_different: Depth where it compounds: core and advanced Python owned properly, not surveyed
The professional toolkit is the syllabus: testing, Git, environments, APIs, automation, concurrency

Pythonic style taught deliberately: comprehensions, iterators and the standard library as a first resort
Certification-aware: the syllabus covers what PCEP and PCAP examine, for students who want the credential road
Real assessment: weekly problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, and a final exam that decides the certificate, with focused revision and a free retest

faqs.question: What does this Python masterclass cover?
faqs.answer: Python to genuine professional depth across nine months: the core language and data structures, object-oriented design, files and exceptions, the standard library used as a first resort, testing with pytest, Git and GitHub, APIs and polite scraping, automation and concurrency, and a final month that tastes the three roads, a real Flask build, a real pandas analysis, a real AI-API tool, before the capstone and final exam.

faqs.question: How long does it take to learn Python properly?
faqs.answer: To professional depth: nine months at 2 live classes a week plus 4 to 6 hours of practice, and the course keeps two more months in hand for learners who need them. Two-week Python courses teach syntax; syntax is perhaps a tenth of the skill employers actually test.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Problem sets follow every class with written feedback, monthly reviews deliberately mix new material with earlier topics, each phase ends with an exam, and the course ends with a final exam: a practical build plus written questions from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: Does this course cover web development, data science and AI?
faqs.answer: It covers what makes them possible, deep Python, and then tastes each road honestly in the final month: a deployed Flask app, a pandas analysis, an AI-API tool. Full web, data and AI tracks are their own multi-month disciplines, and we teach them properly in dedicated courses rather than faking them here in survey weeks. Graduates choose their road from experience and continue with the depth those courses assume.

faqs.question: Will this prepare me for PCEP or PCAP certification?
faqs.answer: Yes: the syllabus covers what both exams examine, and the final weeks map it explicitly for students who want the credential. We also run a dedicated PCEP/PCAP preparation course for those who want exam-format drilling specifically.

faqs.question: Is Python still the right language to learn?
faqs.answer: More than ever: it is the language of AI and data, the default automation tool of every industry, and the most commonly listed skill in technical hiring. The AI era raised its value, the people directing AI tools well are the ones who understand the code those tools produce, and Python is where that understanding is cheapest to build.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Can I try a class before enrolling?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo class with no commitment: book at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161. You will write and run real Python inside the demo.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups with a real instructor reading your actual code, never pre-recorded videos. Python habits, good and bad, form in the first months; live correction is what makes them good.
